BEIJING, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Origin Agritech Limited (NASDAQ: SEED) ("Origin" or the "Company"), a leading Chinese agricultural technology company, today announced that on October 27, 2026, it received a written notice (the "Notice") from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") stating that, for the last 30 consecutive business days, the closing bid price of the Company’s ordinary shares had been below the minimum $1.00 per share required for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) (the "Minimum Bid Price Requirement").

The Notice has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company’s ordinary shares, which will continue to trade on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "SEED."

In accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A), the Company has been provided a compliance period of 180 calendar days, or until April 26, 2027, to regain compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement. To regain compliance, the closing bid price of the Company’s ordinary shares must be at least $1.00 per share for at least 10 consecutive business days during the compliance period. If the minimum closing bid price is met, Nasdaq will provide written confirmation of compliance, and the matter will be closed. Nasdaq may, in its discretion, require the Company to maintain a closing bid price of at least $1.00 per share for a period in excess of ten consecutive business days, but generally no more than 20 consecutive business days, before determining that the Company has demonstrated an ability to maintain long-term compliance.

If the Company does not regain compliance by April 26, 2027, the Company may be eligible for an additional 180-calendar-day compliance period. To qualify, the Company will be required to meet the continued listing requirement for market value of publicly held shares and all other initial listing standards for The Nasdaq Capital Market, with the exception of the bid price requirement, and will need to provide written Notice to Nasdaq of its intention to cure the deficiency during the second compliance period, by effecting a reverse stock split, if necessary. If the Company does not qualify for the second compliance period, or if it appears to Nasdaq that the Company will not be able to cure the deficiency, Nasdaq will provide written Notice that the Company’s ordinary shares are subject to delisting. At that time, the Company will be entitled to appeal the delisting determination to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

The Company intends to actively monitor the closing bid price of its ordinary shares and will consider available options to regain compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement within the compliance period, which may include, if necessary, effecting a reverse stock split. There can be no assurance, however, that the Company will be able to regain compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement or maintain compliance with Nasdaq’s other continued listing requirements.

This press release is being issued in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(b), which requires the Company to publicly disclose its receipt of the Notice. The Company will also furnish a copy of this press release to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Form 6-K.

About Origin Agritech Limited

Origin Agritech Limited, founded in 1997 and headquartered at the Origin R&D Center in Songzhuang, Tongzhou, Beijing, is a leading Chinese agricultural technology company. In crop seed biotechnology, Origin Agritech’s phytase corn was the first transgenic corn to receive a Biosafety Certificate from China’s Ministry of Agriculture. Over the years, Origin has established a robust biotechnology seed pipeline, including products with glyphosate tolerance and Bt (pest resistance) traits. MCLEAN, VA / ACCESS Newswire / October 30, 2026 / Gladstone Investment Corporation (Nasdaq:GAIN) ("Gladstone Investment") is pleased to announce its support of Smart Chemical Solutions, LLC ("Smart Chemical"), alongside Xyresic Capital ("Xyresic"), in its acquisition of Polymer Technologies, LLC ("Polymer Technologies").

Smart Chemical is a leading provider of production chemicals for onshore oil and gas operators, with additional custom-tailored chemical solutions for the fuel additives, agricultural, water treatment and industrial markets. Polymer Technologies, headquartered in Plainville, Kansas, has provided polymer-gel well services to oil and gas operators since 1989. Its proprietary treatments help operators reduce unwanted water production by identifying and sealing fractures, high-permeability channels, casing leaks and other pathways that allow water to move through a well or reservoir, lowering water handling and disposal costs and improving the economics of existing wells.

The acquisition expands Smart Chemical's oilfield offering of specialty chemicals beyond production, fuel additives, and water treatment into differentiated well-intervention and water conformance solutions, giving customers another way to address production challenges in maturing wells. Together, Smart Chemical and Polymer Technologies offer operators a broader suite of production chemicals, water treatment programs and polymer-gel conformance treatments, supported by field service and technical application expertise.

"Polymer Technologies is a great strategic fit for Smart Chemical," said Billy Smith, Chief Executive Officer of Smart Chemical. "Their technology solves a real and growing problem for operators, and it is highly complementary to the production chemicals we already provide."

"Polymer Technologies brings a proprietary, field-proven technology and a talented team, and it directly supports our strategy of growing Smart Chemical by adding differentiated products and services for its customers," said Christopher Lee, Executive Vice President and Senior Managing Director of Gladstone Investment. "We are excited to continue supporting the Smart Chemical team."

Gladstone Investment is a publicly traded business development company that seeks to make equity and secured debt investments in lower middle market businesses in connection with acquisitions, changes in control, and recapitalizations. The Staff Determination was issued pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iv) on the following grounds: (i) the closing bid price of the Company’s Class A ordinary shares was below $1.00 per share for the 30 consecutive business days from September 15, 2026 through October 26, 2026, and therefore the Company was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), which requires a minimum bid price of at least $1.00 per share for continued listing (the “Minimum Bid Price Requirement”); and (ii) the Company is not eligible for any compliance period specified in Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A) because it effected a one-for-twenty-five (1-for-25) reverse share split on March 16, 2026, within the prior one-year period.

The Company intends to timely request a hearing before the Panel to appeal the Staff Determination by November 3, 2026. As stated in the Staff Determination, a timely hearing request will stay the suspension of trading in the Company’s securities and the filing of Form 25-NSE pending the Panel’s decision. During that period, the Company’s Class A ordinary shares will continue to trade on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “MASK.”

The Company is actively evaluating measures to regain compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement, including potential capital markets transactions, financing activities and further share consolidations. RICHMOND, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Accendra Health, Inc. (NYSE: ACH) (the Company) today announced that on October 27, 2026, it received a notice (the “Notice”) from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) notifying the Company that it is not in compliance with Section 802.01B of the NYSE’s continued listing standards that the Company have an average market capitalization of not less than $50.0 million over a consecutive 30 trading-day period and stockholders’ equity of not less than $50.0 million. The Notice does not result in the immediate delisting of the Company’s Class A Common Stock (the “Common Stock”) from the NYSE.

The Company intends to respond to the NYSE within ten business days of receipt of the Notice affirming its intent to submit a business plan. Pursuant to Section 802.01B, the Company has a period of 45 calendar days following receipt of the Notice to submit a business plan that demonstrates how the Company intends to regain compliance with Section 802.01B within 18 months of receipt of the Notice. DALLAS, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United States Lime & Minerals, Inc. (NASDAQ: USLM) today reported third quarter 2026 results: The Company’s revenues in the third quarter 2026 were $106.2 million, compared to $102.0 million in the third quarter 2025, an increase of $4.2 million, or 4.1%. For the first nine months 2026, the Company’s revenues were $293.1 million, compared to $284.8 million in the first nine months 2025, an increase of $8.4 million, or 2.9%. The increase in revenues in the third quarter 2026, compared to the third quarter 2025, resulted primarily from modest increases in both average sales prices and sales volumes. Increased sales volumes were principally due to increased demand from the Company’s steel customers, partially offset by reduced demand from the Company’s construction customers. The increase in revenues in the first nine months 2026, compared to the first nine months 2025, resulted primarily from modest increases in both average sales prices and sales volumes. Increased sales volumes were principally due to increased demand from the Company’s steel customers, partially offset by reduced demand from the Company’s roof shingle customers.

The Company’s gross profit was $50.8 million in the third quarter 2026, compared to $52.2 million in the third quarter 2025, a decrease of $1.4 million, or 2.7%. The Company’s gross profit was $139.2 million in the first nine months 2026, compared to $140.2 million in the first nine months 2025, a decrease of $1.0 million, or 0.7%. The decreases in gross profit in the third quarter and first nine months 2026, compared to the comparable 2025 periods, resulted primarily from higher transportation and fuel costs, driven principally by higher diesel costs, and production inefficiencies experienced during the integration of our new Texas kiln into our existing plant operations.

Selling, general and administrative (“SG&A”) expenses were $6.1 million in the third quarter 2026, compared to $5.9 million in the third quarter 2025, an increase of $0.1 million, or 2.3%. SG&A expenses were $18.1 million in the first nine months 2026, compared to $18.4 million in the first nine months 2025, a decrease of $0.3 million, or 1.5%.

Other (income) expense, net was $3.8 million and $10.4 million income in the third quarter and first nine months 2026, compared to $3.4 million and $9.6 million income in the third quarter and first nine months 2025, increases of $0.4 million and $0.8 million, respectively. The increases in other (income) expense, net for the third quarter and first nine months 2026, compared to the comparable 2025 periods, were primarily due to interest earned on higher average balances of cash and cash equivalents.

The Company reported net income of $38.0 million ($1.32 per share diluted) and $103.1 million ($3.58 per share diluted) in the third quarter and first nine months 2026, compared to $38.8 million ($1.35 per share diluted) and $103.7 million ($3.61 per share diluted) in the third quarter and first nine months 2025, decreases of $0.7 million, or 1.9%, and $0.6 million, or 0.6%, respectively.

“We saw modest increases in both volumes and sales prices for our lime and limestone products in the third quarter 2026, while our expenses reflected the impact of the sharp rise in diesel prices,” said Timothy W. Byrne, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Although we remain optimistic regarding overall construction demand in the future, certain large construction projects have recently experienced delays for various reasons, including securing permits, and we are monitoring indications that Texas’ residential construction is beginning to slow down. The new kiln at our Texas facility began intermittently producing quicklime in the third quarter, and we expect to have final commissioning completed in the fourth quarter. To that end, our costs in Texas have been impacted by production inefficiencies as we continue to integrate the new kiln into our existing plant operations,” Mr. Byrne added.

The Company announced today that the Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share on the Company’s common stock. This dividend is payable on December 11, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 20, 2026.

United States Lime & Minerals, Inc., a NASDAQ-listed public company with headquarters in Dallas, Texas, is a manufacturer of lime and limestone products, supplying primarily the construction (including highway, road, and building contractors), industrial (including paper and glass manufacturers), environmental (including municipal sanitation and water treatment facilities and flue gas treatment processes), metals (including steel producers), roof shingle manufacturers, agriculture (including poultry producers), and oil and gas services industries. The Company operates lime and limestone plants and distribution facilities in Arkansas, Colorado, Louisiana, Missouri, Oklahoma, and Texas through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Arkansas Lime Company, ART Quarry TRS LLC (DBA Carthage Crushed Limestone), Colorado Lime Company, Mill Creek Dolomite, LLC, Texas Lime Company, U.S. Lime Company, U.S. Lime Company-Shreveport, U.S. Lime Company-St. Clair, and U.S. Lime Company-Transportation. “Tenants choose Harbor Point for what surrounds the office from the waterfront to the retail and restaurants,” said Shawn Tibbetts, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of AH Realty Trust. “The combination of new leasing, tenant expansion and renewal activity demonstrates our focus on attracting and retaining tenants, and the demand for communities like Harbor Point.”

At Thames Street Wharf, Arena Analytics signed a 1,700-square-foot lease with occupancy expected in November 2026. BluePath Finance leased nearly 5,000 square feet and took occupancy in September 2026.

At Wills Wharf, existing tenant Cole Schotz P.C. is relocating to a larger, nearly 9,000-square-foot space in the building, expanding its footprint by approximately 2,000 square feet. Law firm Zuckerman Spaeder LLP has leased Cole Schotz’s former nearly 7,000 square-foot space. Both tenants are expected to occupy their new space in mid-2027. RBC Royal Bank also renewed its lease for over 7,000 square feet.  

Located along Baltimore’s waterfront, Harbor Point combines Class A office space, retail, dining and residential uses in a mixed-use setting. AH Realty Trust’s holdings include the T. Rowe Price global headquarters, Thames Street Wharf, Wills Wharf and the Constellation Energy Building.

AH Realty Trust (NYSE: AHRT) is a real estate investment trust ("REIT") with over four decades of experience. The company owns and operates high-quality retail and mixed-use office assets located primarily in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern United States. AH Realty Trust focuses on disciplined capital allocation and value creation for shareholders. For more information, visit AHRealtyTrust.com.

JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: HWBK), (the “Company”), the bank holding company for Hawthorn Bank, reported third quarter 2026 net income of $7.1 million, or earnings per diluted share (“EPS”) of $1.01.

Third Quarter 2026 Results

  • Net income improved $0.9 million, or 15.2%, to $7.1 million from the third quarter 2025 (the "prior year quarter"). Adjusted net income(a) for the third quarter 2026 was $8.6 million. The efficiency ratio was 65.00% compared to 62.30% for the prior year quarter. The adjusted efficiency ratio(a) for the third quarter 2026 was 55.64%.
  • EPS of $1.01, an improvement of $0.13 per share, or 15%, from the prior year quarter. Adjusted EPS(a) for the third quarter 2026 was $1.23, an increase of 38.2% over the prior year quarter.
  • Net interest margin, fully taxable equivalent ("FTE") improved in the third quarter 2026 to 4.41% compared to 4.16% for the second quarter 2026 (the "prior quarter”) and 3.97% for the prior year quarter
  • Provision for credit losses was $0.1 million higher than the prior quarter
  • Return on average assets and equity of 1.48% and 14.91%, respectively. Adjusted return on average assets(a) and equity(a) of 1.80% and 18.17%, respectively.
  • Loans increased $273.8 million, or 19.3%, and deposits increased $302.8 million, or 20.3%, compared to the prior quarter, mainly due to acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.
  • Investments increased $41.7 million, or 17.7%, compared to the prior quarter, mainly due to acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.
  • Credit quality remained stable with non-performing assets to total loans of 0.59% compared to 0.48% in the prior year quarter
  • Remained "well capitalized" with total risk-based capital of 14.29%
  • Book value per share was $27.29, an increase of $0.79, or 3.0%, compared to the prior quarter and $3.53, or 14.9%, compared to the prior year quarter. Tangible book value per common share(a) was $23.58 for the third quarter 2026.

Financial Results for the Third Quarter 2026
Earnings

Net income for the third quarter 2026 was $7.1 million, a decrease of $0.26 million, or 3.6%, from the prior quarter, and an increase of $0.9 million, or 15.2%, from the prior year quarter. Diluted EPS decreased to $1.01 for the third quarter 2026 compared to $1.06 for the prior quarter and $0.88 for the prior year quarter.

Net Interest Income and Net Interest Margin

Net interest income for the third quarter 2026 was $19.3 million, an increase of $2.0 million from the prior quarter, and an increase of $2.4 million from the prior year quarter.

Interest income increased $1.8 million compared to the prior year quarter, driven primarily by higher rates on earning assets in the current quarter, while interest expense decreased $0.7 million compared to the prior year quarter due to lower costs on deposits. Net interest margin, on an FTE basis, was 4.41% for the current quarter, compared to 4.16% for the prior quarter, and 3.97% for the prior year quarter.

The yield earned on average loans held for investment increased to 6.42%, on an FTE basis, for the third quarter 2026, compared to 6.18% for the prior quarter and 6.12% for the prior year quarter.

The average cost of deposits was 2.13% for the third quarter 2026, compared to 2.13% for the prior quarter and 2.36% for the prior year quarter. Non-interest bearing demand deposits as a percent of total deposits was 26.6% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 28.0% and 27.8% at June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively.

Non-interest Income

Total non-interest income for the third quarter 2026 was $3.7 million, a decrease of $1.7 million, or 31.1%, from the prior quarter, and no change from the prior year quarter. The decrease during the quarter was primarily due the recognition of a gain on the sale of a bank administrative office that was no longer being used in the prior quarter that did not recur during the third quarter 2026.  

Non-interest Expense

Total non-interest expense for the third quarter 2026 was $14.9 million, an increase of $1.2 million, or 8.7%, from the prior quarter, and an increase of $2.1 million, or 16.6%, from the prior year quarter.

The third quarter 2026 efficiency ratio was 65.00% compared to 60.73% and 62.30% for the prior quarter and prior year quarter, respectively. The improvement in the current quarter compared to the prior year quarter was primarily due to higher net interest margin and an increase in non-interest income.

Acquisition related expenses for the third quarter 2026 was $2.0 million, an increase of $1.4 million, or 251.2%, from the prior quarter. No acquisition related expenses were paid in the prior year quarter.

Income Taxes

Total income tax provision expense for the third quarter 2026 was $0.8 million, a decrease of $0.8 million, or 51.1%, from the prior quarter, and a decrease of $0.6 million, or 42.2%, from the prior year quarter, reflecting an effective tax rate of 10.0%, 17.96%,and 18.1%, respectively. The decrease in the effective tax rate during the third quarter 2026 was due to the utilization of federal income tax credits purchased at a discount which reduced tax expense during the quarter.

Loans

Loans held for investment increased $273.8 million, or 19.3%, to $1.69 billion as of September 30, 2026 compared to June 30, 2026, and increased $176.1 million, or 11.6% from September 30, 2025. The increases are mainly attributed to the acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.

Investments

Investments increased $41.7 million, or 17.7%, to $277.9 million as of September 30, 2026 compared to June 30, 2026, and increased $51.9 million, or 23.0%, from September 30, 2025. The increases are mainly attributed to the acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.

Asset Quality

Non-performing assets to total loans was 0.59% at September 30, 2026, 0.53% at June 30, 2026, and 0.48% at September 30, 2025. Non-performing assets totaled $9.9 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $7.5 million and $7.3 million at June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively. The increase in the current year quarter compared to the prior year quarter was due to an increase in non-accrual loans within the commercial loan segment.

In the third quarter 2026, the Company had net loan charge-offs of $0.07 million, or 0.02% annualized, of average loans, compared to net loan charge-offs of $0.14 million, or 0.04% of average loans, and $0.04 million, or 0.01% annualized, of average loans, in the prior quarter and prior year quarter, respectively.

The Company provided a provision for credit losses of $0.3 million for the third quarter 2026 compared to providing a $0.2 million provision in the prior quarter, and providing a $0.4 million provision for the prior year quarter.

The allowance for credit losses at September 30, 2026 was $24.4 million, or 1.45% of outstanding loans, and 248.71% of non-performing loans. At June 30, 2026, the allowance for credit losses was $20.7 million, or 1.46% of outstanding loans, and 311.50% of non-performing loans. At September 30, 2025, the allowance for credit losses was $21.9 million, or 1.45% of outstanding loans, and 446.02% of non-performing loans. The allowance for credit losses represents management’s best estimate of expected losses inherent in the loan portfolio and is commensurate with risks in the loan portfolio as of September 30, 2026 as determined by management. The increase in the current quarter is largely driven by the Day 1 allowance for credit losses recorded in conjunction with the acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.

Deposits

Total deposits at September 30, 2026 were $1.79 billion, an increase of $302.8 million, or 20.3%, from June 30, 2026, and an increase of $265.0 million, or 17.4% annualized, from September 30, 2025. The increases were mainly attributed to the acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.

Capital

The Company maintains its “well capitalized” regulatory capital position. At September 30, 2026, capital ratios were as follows: total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets 14.29%; tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets 13.04%; common equity tier 1 10.15%; tier 1 leverage 12.59%; and common equity to assets 8.92%.

Pursuant to the Company's Repurchase Plan, management is given discretion to determine the number and pricing of the shares to be purchased under the plan, as well as the timing of any such purchases. The Board of Directors amended the plan on July 29, 2026 to increase the authorized repurchase limit to $10 million. The Company repurchased 12,000 common shares under the repurchase plan during the first nine months of 2026 at an average cost of $32.68 per share totaling $0.4 million. As of September 30, 2026, $10.0 million remains available for share repurchases pursuant to the plan.

 On October 30, 2026, the Company's Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per common share, payable January 1, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026.

Merger with FSC Bancshares, Inc.

On September 3, 2026, the Company completed its acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiary, Farmers State Bank (collectively, “FSC”) whereby FSC Bancshares, Inc. was merged with and into Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. and Farmers State Bank was merged with and into Hawthorn Bank. Pursuant to the merger agreement executed on April 29, 2026, the Company paid $17.0 million of cash consideration and issued 413,042 shares of Company stock. The Company and the Bank assumed all of the assets and liabilities of the FSC entities with which they merged by operation of law. The acquisition added 9 full-service branch locations located in northern Missouri.

Farmers State Bank's results of operations were included in Hawthorn's consolidated results of operations beginning September 3, 2026. Hawthorn will operate Farmers State Bank as a separate division of Hawthorn Bank until it is merges with and into Hawthorn Bank, which is expected to occur in March 2027.
